name: Yesterday Today
summary: This EA trades breakouts of yesterday's high and low levels, entering long when price breaks above yesterday's high and short when price breaks below yesterday's low. It is a classic daily breakout system that exploits the tendency of price to continue moving after breaching the previous day's extremes. The strategy uses simple pending-order-style logic with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA交易昨日高低点突破策略，当价格突破昨日最高价时做多，突破昨日最低价时做空。这是一个经典的日线突破系统，利用价格突破前一日极值后继续运行的惯性获利。策略使用简单的突破逻辑，并配置了可调的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于昨日高低点突破，属于经典的日内突破交易方法。入场条件为：当当前价格向上突破昨日最高价时开多单，当当前价格向下突破昨日最低价时开空单。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，也可能在交易日结束时平仓。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算，具体取决于参数配置。资金管理方面，EA依赖止损来控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体账户风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损后的仓位调整。该策略的核心假设是昨日高低点的突破会引发趋势延续，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假突破信号导致连续止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on yesterday's high/low breakout, a classic intraday breakout trading method. Entry conditions: open a long position when the current price breaks above yesterday's high, and open a short position when the current price breaks below yesterday's low. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit levels, and may also close positions at the end of the trading day. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or a percentage of equity calculation, depending on parameter configuration. In terms of money management, the EA relies on stop losses to control per-trade risk but lacks overall account risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or position adjustment after consecutive losses. The core assumption of this strategy is that breakouts of yesterday's high/low will trigger trend continuation, but it is prone to frequent false breakout signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive stop losses.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
利用昨日高低点是市场公认的有效支撑阻力位
突破策略在趋势行情中盈亏比良好
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
Yesterday's high/low are widely recognized effective support/resistance levels
Breakout strategies have good risk-reward ratios in trending markets
cons: 震荡行情中频繁虚假突破导致连续亏损
缺乏过滤机制如波动率或成交量确认
没有动态仓位管理或加仓逻辑，资金利用率低
cons_en: Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
Lacks filtering mechanisms such as volatility or volume confirmation
No dynamic position sizing or pyramiding logic, resulting in low capital utilization
improvements: 增加ATR或波动率过滤，避免在低波动震荡行情中入场
加入成交量确认或多时间框架趋势过滤以提高突破有效性
实现动态止损移动和分批止盈以优化盈利
improvements_en: Add ATR or volatility filter to avoid entering in low-volatility ranging markets
Incorporate volume confirmation or multi-timeframe trend filter to improve breakout validity
Implement trailing stop and partial profit-taking to optimize gains

risk_points: 缺乏虚假突破过滤机制，震荡市容易连续止损
固定手数交易未根据账户风险动态调整
可能缺少新K线检查导致同一突破点重复开仓
risk_points_en: Lacks false breakout filtering mechanism, prone to consecutive stop losses in ranging markets
Fixed lot trading does not dynamically adjust based on account risk
May lack new bar check, potentially leading to repeated entries at the same breakout level
